definitions.gloss: acquisition cost; purchase cost; cost basis
definitions.explanation: The total amount originally paid to acquire an asset such as land, a building, or shares, including related fees. When the asset is later sold, this figure is subtracted from the sale price to calculate the taxable gain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取得費|しゅとくひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: To look up the acquisition cost of the land.

examples.japanese: {取得費|しゅとくひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: If you don't know the acquisition cost, you can't calculate the tax.

examples.japanese: ⟦{売却|ばいきゃく}→売却：12123_baikyaku⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{取得費|しゅとくひ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いた→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The profit is the sale price minus the acquisition cost and the fees.

notes:
⟦{取得|しゅとく}→取得：11947_shutoku⟧ (acquisition) + ⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧ (cost, expense). Mainly a tax and accounting term; in everyday conversation people say ⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧ instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {取得費|しゅとくひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{差|さ}し{引|ひ}く→差し引く：06701_sashihiku⟧: to deduct the acquisition cost
- {取得費|しゅとくひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不明|ふめい}→不明：11352_fumei⟧: the acquisition cost is unknown
- {取得費|しゅとくひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{含|ふく}める→含める：02408_fukumeru⟧: to include in the acquisition cost

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {購入費|こうにゅうひ}: purchase expense — the everyday cost of buying something, without the tax-calculation sense
- ⟦{譲渡費用|じょうとひよう}→譲渡費用：30260_joutohiyou⟧: transfer expenses — the costs of *selling*, deducted alongside the acquisition cost
